name: Functional Composition Predicate
description: Replaced the direct XOR/AND bitwise logic predicate with a mathematical function composition requirement. Solvers must evaluate the compositions of f_1(x)=-x and f_2(x)=1/x to realize that the target composition -1/x is achieved if and only if the two nodes are assigned different rules. This forces the model to perform algebraic substitution before discovering the underlying bipartite graph structure.
